observations: Two large concentric-spiral forms dominate the center and right, built from overlapping loops in yellow, red, green, and black lines on a pale ground.
A horizontal band of dense black-and-white zigzag marks runs across the lower third, flanked above and below by thick yellow outlines forming a boxy enclosure.
The left edge carries a vertical column of small open ovals in dark outline, while white scribble lines and a light-blue field fill the upper corners and background.
reading: Two spiral knots pull the eye inward while the image holds them apart, creating a push-pull felt before any shape resolves. Loose white scribbles at the edges keep the composition from closing, leaving the whole thing slightly unresolved, which reads as a considered state rather than an incomplete one.
